spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Thin, emaciated, wasted, declined.
2 Weak, feeble.
3 Sharpened, whetted.
E.
शि to sharpen, or शो to pare or whet, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Cold, chilly, frigid.
2 Idle, lazy.
3 Cold, dull, apathetic, stupid.
4 Decocted, boiled.
n. (-तं)
1 Cold, coldness.
2

Water.
3

Cold weather or the six months of the rainy, dewy and cold seasons.
m. (-तः)
A small tree, (Cordia myxa.)
2 A kind of ratan, (Calamus fasciculatus.)
3 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.)
4 The Nīmb tree.
5 Camphor.
f. (-ता)
1 The wife of

RĀMA.
2

A furrow.
E.
श्यै to go, aff. क्त, the fem. form more usually occurs सीता, q. v.

mfn. (-तः-ता or -ती-तं)
1

White.
2

Bound, tied.
3 Finished, destroyed.
4 Completed, concluded.
5 Known.
m. (-तः)
1 White, (the colour.)
2 The planet

VENUS.
3

An arrow.
n. (-तं)
1

Silver.
2

Sandal.
f. (-ता)
1 Clayed or candied sugar.
2 Arabian jasmine.
3 A sort of

Clitoria.
4

Bent grass with white blossoms.
5

Moonlight.
6

Spirituous liquor.
7 A handsome or well made woman.
E.
षि to tie or bind, aff. क्त; or षो to destroy, क्त aff., and इ substituted for the radical vowel.

f. (-ता)
1 A furrow, the track of the plough-share.
2 The daughter of JANAKA and wife of

RĀMACANDRA.
3
One of the four great branches into which the Ganges, after having fallen on mount Meru, is fabled to divide: the eastern branch, flowing into the Varṣa

Bhadrāśva.
4

The goddess LAKṢMĪ.
5 UMĀ the wife of Ś

IVA.
6
A goddess presiding over fruits, &c. an Indian FLORA or

POMONA.
7

Spirituous liquor.
E.
षि to bind, (the earth,) क्त aff., form irr.; it is then applicable to the princess as having been turned up in the soil by a plough-share; and to the goddess, as they may be supposed to have been incarnate in the wife of RĀMA; also, as differently derived शीता, q. v.

f. (-ता)
Sharpness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शितत्वं.

f. (-ता)
Cold, coldness.
E.
शीत, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीतत्वं.

f. (-द्रुः)
The Śatadru or Setlej river.
E.
शित weakened, द्रु to flow, aff. कुः see शतद्रु.

m. (-द्रुः)
A plant, commonly Moraṭā.
E.
सित white, and द्रु a tree.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Sharp-edged.
E.
शित, and धारा an edge.

Barley.
2

Wheat.
E.
शित sharpened, शूक the beard.

m. (-कः)
Barley.
E.
शीत cold, and शूक an awn or beard.

m. (-कः)
Barley.
E.
शित white, and शूक an awn or ear.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
Sharp-pointed.
m. (-ग्रः)
A thorn.
E.
शित, and अग्र point.

m. (-ग्रः)
A thorn.
E.
सित white, and अग्र point.

m. (-भृत्)
Armed with sharp weapons.
E.
शित, अस्त्र a weapon, भृत् who has.

Black.
2

White.
m. (-तिः)
The Bhojpatra or birch.
E.
शि to sharpen, क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.; or शत to go, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and इ substituted for the radical vowel; also सिति.

White.
2

Black.
E.
सि to bind, aff. क्ति.

IVA.
2

A gallinule.
3 A peacock.
E.
शिति black, and कण्ठ the throat.

m. (-रः)
A potherb, (apparently Marsilea dentata, Rox.)

m. (-दः)
A goose.
E.
शिति white, छद a feather; also सितछद.

m. (-क्षः)
A goose.
E.
शिति white, पक्ष a wing; also सितपक्ष.

n. (-त्नं)
A sapphire.
E.
शिति, and रत्न a gem.

m. (-कः)
A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.)
E.
शिति black, and सार essence, resin, कन् added; yielding a strong black resin that is used for caulking boats, &c.

m. (-षुः)
A sharp arrow.
E.
शित, and इषु an arrow.

m. (-कः)
1 Cold weather or the cold season, winter.
2 A lazy man, one who is dilatory or dull.
3 One devoid of care or anxiety, a happy man.
4 A plant, (Marsilea dentata.)
5 A scorpion.
E.
क added to the preceding.

n. (-लं)
Cold weather, winter.
E.
शीत, and काल time.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Produced in winter.
E.
शीतकाल, and ख aff.

m. (-च्छ्रः)
A religious penance, drinking cold water three days, cold milk three days, cold Ghee three days, and fasting three.
E.
शीत cold, and कृच्छ्र penance.

m. (-म्भः)
A flower, (Nerium odorum.)
f. (-म्भा)
An aquatic plant.
E.
शीत cold, कुम्भ a water-pot.

n. (-रं)
Refined Borax.
E.
शीत cold, and क्षार nitre.

n. (-न्धं)
White Sandal.
E.
शीत cold, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-गुः)
The moon.
E.
शीत cold, and गु neut. form of गो a ray of light, here forming a masc. compound.

m. (-कः)
1 A lamp.
2 Pleasing, satisfying.
3 A mirror.
E.
शीत cold, cool, and चम्पक a flower.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, (Cleome pentaphylla.)
E.
शीत cool, पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-वः)
A plant, (Ardisea solanacea.)
E.
शीत cool, and पल्लव a shoot.

f. (-नी)
A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli.
E.
शीत the cold (in a cold climate), पाक ripening, and इनि aff.

f. (-की)
1 A medicinal root, commonly

Kākoli.
2

A plant, (Sida cordifolia.)
E.
शीत cold, (in cold weather, &c.) पाक a ripening, ङीप् fem. aff.

m. (-ष्पः)
The Sirisha tree.
n. (-ष्पं)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
शीत cold, (in the cold weather, &c.) and पुष्प a flower.

n. (-ष्पं)
A sort of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
m. (-ष्पः)
1 A sort of tree, the Tagara tree.
2 A kind of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
f. (-ष्पा)
Arabian jasmine.
E.
सित white, and पुष्प a flower.

n. (-कं)
Storax or Benzoin.
E.
शीत cold (in the snowy mountains), पुष्प a flower, कन् aff.

m. (-भः)
Camphor.
E.
शीत cool, and प्रभ shining.

m. (-नुः)
The moon.
E.
शीत cool, and भानु the sun.

f. (-रुः)
Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.)
E.
शीत the cold, and भीरु afraid.

mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि)
Eating cold viands.
E.
शीत, भुज to eat, णिनि aff.

m. (-खः)
1 The moon.
2 Camphor.
E.
शीत cool, मयूख a ray of light.

m. (-चिः)
The moon.
E.
शीत cool, मरीचि a ray.

n. (-कं)
The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
E.
शीत cool, and मूलक a root.

m. (-म्यः)
A lamp.
E.
शीत cool, and रम्य agreeable.

m. (-रुक्)
The moon.
E.
शीत, and रुच् light.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Cold, chilly, frigid.
n. (-लं)
1 Green vitriol.
2

Storax.
3

Sandal.
4
White

Sandal.
5

A lotus.
6 A pearl.
7 Cold, coldness.
8 The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
m. (-लः)
1 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.)
2 A Jina or Jaina teacher, the 10th of the twenty-four

Tīrthakaras.
3
A religious ceremony observed upon the sun's entering

Aries.
4

The moon.
5 A small tree, (Cordia myxa.)
6 The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.)
7 A sort of camphor.
8 Turpentine.
f. (-ला-ली)
1 A plant, perhaps intending the Phrynium dichotymum, from the split stems of which a smooth, cool mat is made, thence termed

Sitalpāti.
2

Small-pox.
3 The goddess presiding over or inflicting small-pox.
E.
शीत cool, लच् poss. aff., or ला to give or get, aff. क.

f. (-ता)
Coldness, coolness.
E.
शीतल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीतलत्वं.

f. (-ता)
Doob or Dūrbbā grass with white blossoms.
E.
सित white, and लता a creeper^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-दः)
Sandal.
E.
शीतल cold, and प्रद who gives.

m. (-तः)
A cool wind.
E.
शीतल, and वात wind.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.)
E.
शीतल cool, वात wind, कन् added.

f. (-ष्ठी)
The sixth of the light half of Māgha, when only cold food is eaten.
E.
शीतल, and षष्ठी sixth.

n. (-वं)
1 A sort of resin, (Storax benzoin.)
2 Rock salt.
m. (-वः)
1 A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa.)
2 The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.)
E.
शीत cool, and शिव auspicious.

n. (-वं)
Rock salt.
E.
सित white, and शिव auspicious; also शितशिवं, सितसिवं.

n. (-वं)
Rock salt.
E.
सित white, and सिव for शिव auspicious; also सितशिव, &c.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Bearing or enduring cold.
m. (-हः)
A Pīlu, or tree so named, growing in the Himāla mountains.
E.
शीत cold, and सह enduring.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Removing cold.
E.
शीत, and हर what takes.

Camphor.
2

The moon.
E.
शीत cold, अंशु a ray.

m. (-शुः)
The moon.
E.
सित, and अंशु a ray.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Benumbed, frozen.
E.
शीत, and आकुल perplexed.

m. (-दः)
Scorbutic affection of the gums.
E.
शीत, and अद what eats.

m. (-द्रिः)
The snowy mountains.
E.
शीत cold, and अद्रि a mountain.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Cold, chilled, shivering, suffering or shrinking from cold.
E.
शीत cold, and आर्त्त pained.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Cold, shivering, shrinking from cold.
E.
शीत cold, आलुच् aff., here implying aversion or impatience.

m. (-श्मा)
The moon gem, crystal.
E.
शीत cold, अश्मन् a stone.

m. (-वः)
1 Final emancipation.
2 Coolness, composure.
3 Cold, coldness.
E.
शीत cold, भाव nature, च्चि augment.

n. (-मं)
Water.
E.
शीत cold, उत्तम best.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
1 Ploughed, tilled: more usually सीत्य.
2 To be cooled or chilled.
E.
शीत cold, or शीता a furrow, यत् aff.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Ploughed, tilled.
n. (-त्यं)
Corn, grain, rice, &c.
E.
सीता a furrow, यत् aff.; also शीत्य.

m. (-रः)
Uttering a sound expressive of pleasurable sensations.
E.
शीत् imitative sound, and कार making; also with कृत made, uttered, शीत्कृत n. (-तं).

n. (-रं)
Uttering an inarticulate sound, such as is made with the lips when a person shivers with cold, or in fainting, sighing, &c.
E.
सीत् imitative sound, and कार making; also सीत्कृत n. (-तं).

INDRA.
2

INDRA'S elephant.
E.
सित white, कुञ्जर an elephant.

m. (-ह्नः)
A sort of fish, (Lacerta scincus.)
E.
सित white, चिह्न a mark.

n. (-चं)
A white umbrella, especially as one of the emblems of royalty.
f. (-त्री)
A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.)
E.
सित white, and छच an umbrella.

m. (-दः)
A goose.
f. (-दा)
White Dūrbbā grass.
E.
सित white, and छद a feather or leaf.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
सित white, and दीधिति a ray of light.

f. (-र्व्वा)
A bent grass with white blossoms.
E.
सित white, and दूर्व्वा Doob grass.

m. (-तुः)
Chalk.
E.
सित white, and धातु a mineral.

m. (-क्षः)
A goose.
E.
सित white, पक्ष a feather.

n. (-चं)
White pepper.
E.
सित white, and मरिच pepper.

m. (-षः)
A sort of bean, (Dolichos catjang.)
E.
सित white, and माष pulse.

m. (-नः)
Yellow, (the colour.)
E.
सित white, and रञ्जन colouring.

m. (-श्मिः)
The moon.
E.
सित white, and रश्मि a ray.

m. (-कः)
Wheat.
E.
सित white, and शिम्बिका an awn; also read शितशिम्बिक, &c.

m. (-प्तिः)
A name of ARJUNA.
E.
सित white, and सप्ति a horse.

m. (-पः)
White mustard.
E.
सित white, and सर्षप mustard.

f. (-न्धुः)
The Ganges.
E.
सित white, and सिन्धु a river.

m. (-ण्डः)
Clayed sugar, said to be prepared from honey.
E.
सित white, आखण्ड sugar.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A kind of fish, (Lacerta scincus.)
E.
सित white, and अङ्क a mark or spot.

m. (-दिः)
Treacle, molasses.
E.
सिता sugar, before दा to give, aff. कि.

m. (-नः)
GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
E.
सित white, आनन face.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A peacock.
E.
सित white, and अपाङ्ग the angle of the eye.

n. (-ब्जं)
The white lotus.
E.
सित white, and अब्ज a lotus.

m. (-भः)
Camphor.
E.
सित white, आङ् before भा to shine, aff. ड.

mn. (-भ्रः-भ्रं)
Camphor.
E.
सित white, and अभ्र a cloud, also with कन् added, सिताभ्रक n. (-कं).

m. (-रः)
An ascetic wearing white garments.
E.
सित white, and अम्बर vesture.

n. (-जं)
A white lotus.
E.
सित white, and अम्भोज a lotus.

m. (-श्वः)
ARJUNA.
E.
सित white, and अश्व a horse.

f. (-का)
A cockle.
E.
सित white, आलि a line, कन् aff., fem. form.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
White and black.
m. (-तः)
A name of BALADEVA.
E.
सित white, (skin,) and असित black, (rainment.)

m. (-मा)
Whiteness.
E.
सिति white, and इमनिच् aff.

m. (-साः)
BALADEVA.
E.
सिति black, and वासस् vesture.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Black.
E.
सित white, इतर reverse.

m. (-तिः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
सितेतर black, (smoke,) गति going.

m. (-रः)
KUVERA.
E.
सित white, and उदर the belly; the deity is properly of a black colour, but is whitened by a leprous taint.

n. (-लं)
Chalk, or a mineral substance of similar appearance, considered as a variety.
m. (-लः)
Crystal.
f. (-ला)
Clayed or candied sugar.
E.
सित white, and उपला a stone.

n. (-णं)
A white umbrella.
E.
सित, and उष्णवारण keeping off the heat.

f. (-तिः)
The hero RĀMA.
E.
सीता the princess, and पति husband.

m. (-तिः)
RĀMA.
E.
सीता in the poss. case, and पति husband.

m. (-कः)
Pease: see सतीलक, सतीनक, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Uttered as an inarticulated sound.
n. (-तं)
An inarticulate sound: see the last.
E.
सीत्, and कृत made.
